{
  "data": "flowchart TB
    subgraph AGENT["AI Agent - untrusted, never sees the key"]
        PY["mu-client.py"]
        TS["mu-client.ts"]
        CP1["cp1-harness.py - 4 test cases"]
    end
    subgraph SOCK["mu-gate (M8) - Unix socket + ed25519 auth"]
        GATE["auth / rate-limit / allowlist"]
    end
    subgraph PIPE["mu-runtime (M6) - pipeline"]
        OM["Omega ceiling check"]
        DL["Delta rules check"]
        HU["mu-human (M9) - biometric confirm above threshold"]
        WL["mu-log (M5) - append-only hash-chain WAL"]
        EX["execute"]
        OM --> DL --> HU --> WL --> EX
    end
    subgraph POL["mu-policy (M2/M3)"]
        PT["policy.toml - daily budget / whitelist / per-resource price caps"]
    end
    subgraph PAY["mu-connect (M7) - settlement"]
        X402["x402 client (M7x) - EIP-712 / EIP-3009"]
        EVM["EVM USDC connector (M7a) - Base"]
        SUI["sui connector"]
        STUB["stub connector (dev, no real payments)"]
    end
    subgraph TRUST["Trust anchors"]
        VAULT["mu-vault (M4) - k256/P-256 keys, soft vault / enclave"]
        CORE["mu-core (M1) - mu-object format"]
        LIC["mu-license - ed25519 license check"]
        DAEMON["mu-daemon - boot protocol + socket server"]
    end
    subgraph OFF["Offline policy management (Composer C2)"]
        CCORE["composer-core - Delta proposals encode/decode"]
        CCLI["composer-cli - whitelist and limit management"]
        CTAURI["composer-tauri - desktop UI"]
    end
    subgraph EXT["External world"]
        BASE["Base chain - USDC, zero gas fees for owner"]
        RES["x402 paid resources (e.g. CoinGecko API)"]
        OWNER["Owner - writes policy, confirms biometrically"]
    end
    subgraph KSGX["KSG edition - planned, for keysingate"]
        KSG["mu-ksg - Solana anchor tx, SPL Memo only, fee only, no money moved"]
        SOL["Solana - network fee per anchor"]
        KSG --> SOL
    end
    PY --> GATE
    TS --> GATE
    CP1 --> GATE
    GATE --> OM
    DL -. "reads rules" .-> PT
    HU <-. "confirm" .-> OWNER
    CCORE -. "policy updates" .-> PT
    CCLI --> CCORE
    CTAURI --> CCORE
    EX --> X402
    EX --> EVM
    EX --> SUI
    EX --> STUB
    EX -. "anchor intent" .-> KSG
    X402 --> RES
    EVM --> BASE
    WL -. "reconcile" .-> BASE
    VAULT -. "signs, key never leaves" .-> X402
    VAULT -. "signs, key never leaves" .-> EVM
",
  "config": null
}
